name: Ak'Zeloth
summary: Neeru Fireblade sends you from Orgrimmar into the Barrens after signs of demonic corruption emerge. His contact waits near the border.

sections.title: A Trail of Shadow
sections.body: Neeru Fireblade says the Burning Blade still threatens the Horde with demonic corruption. After you bring him a Burning Blade insignia collar from Durotar, he sends you into the Barrens. A cult gathers around the Demon Seed, an artifact of vile power, and Neeru wants you to find his contact near the border.

sections.title: The Outpost Contact
sections.body: Ak'Zeloth waits near the Far Watch Post, on the Durotar-Barrens border. Neeru's assistant doubts aloud that his master truly wants the Demon Seed destroyed. He then tells you how to handle the artifact atop Dreadmist Peak.

faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade, a warlock in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow, gives you this request after you present him with a Burning Blade collar.
Ak'Zeloth waits just outside the Far Watch Post, along the eastern Barrens border where the bridge crosses from Durotar.
The Demon Seed is an artifact of demonic power held by the Burning Blade cult atop Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Ak'Zeloth find Neeru's orders strange?
faq.answer: Ak'Zeloth says only that it is strange Neeru wants the Demon Seed destroyed, then agrees to explain how to remove it.
After you speak with Ak'Zeloth, he sends you to climb Dreadmist Peak and neutralize the corrupting relic.

faq.q: Is this quest part of the Burning Blade storyline?
faq.answer: Yes. The Burning Blade cult's activity in Durotar leads into the wider, organized cult activity in the Barrens.

angles.text: As a warlock, you may notice that even Neeru Fireblade's assistant questions the order to destroy a demonic relic.
As an orc, you know the cost of the Burning Legion's grasp. The Burning Blade cult and demonic relics on your doorstep threaten that hard-won freedom.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect the young trade and travel routes linking Durotar with the Barrens by securing the Far Watch Post and clearing Dreadmist Peak.
